description_en: Creates or modifies a silence policy
kebab_example: aliyun arms create-or-update-silence-policy --name silencepolicy_test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOrUpdateSilencePolicy

parameters.help_en:
The silence policy ID.

If this parameter is left empty, a new silence policy is created.
If this parameter is specified, the specified silence policy is modified
parameters.help_zh:
静默策略ID。

不填代表创建新的静默策略。
填写代表修改指定静默策略信息
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The Policy Name of the silence policy
parameters.name: name
matching_rules

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the silence policy is enabled. Valid values:
enable: Enabled.
disable: Disabled
parameters.help_zh: 静默策略是否启用，enable 启用，disable 停用
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The effective period type of the silence policy. Valid values:
PERMANENT: permanently effective.
CUSTOM_TIME: effective during a custom time period.
CYCLE_EFFECT: loop effective
parameters.help_zh: 静默策略生效时间类型，PERMANENT - 永久生效，CUSTOM_TIME - 自定义时间段生效，CYCLE_EFFECT - 循环生效
parameters.name: effective_time_type

parameters.help_en:
The cycle period. This parameter is required when the effective time type is CYCLE_EFFECT (cyclically effective). Valid values:
DAY: daily cycle.
WEEK: weekly cycle
parameters.help_zh: 循环周期，当静默策略生效类型为CYCLE_EFFECT（循环生效）时必填。DAY-按天循环，WEEK-按周循环
parameters.name: time_period

parameters.help_en: The effective time period of the notification policy. When the effective time type is CUSTOM_TIME (custom time period), the input format is [{"startTime":"2024-08-04 22:13","endTime":"2024-08-04 22:21"}]. When the effective time type is CYCLE_EFFECT (cyclically effective) and the effective period is DAY (daily cycle), the input format is [{"startTime":"22:13","endTime":"22:21"}] (the start time cannot be earlier than the end time). When the effective time type is CYCLE_EFFECT (cyclically effective) and the effective period is WEEK (weekly cycle), the input format is [{"startWeek":"1", "endWeek":"2" "startTime":"22:13","endTime":"22:21"}] (the week parameter value ranges from 1 to 7, and the start time cannot be earlier than the end time)
parameters.help_zh: 通知策略生效时间段。当生效时间类型为CUSTOM_TIME(自定义时间段时)，输入格式为[{"startTime":"2024-08-04 22:13","endTime":"2024-08-04 22:21"}]。当生效时间类型为CYCLE_EFFECT（循环生效），且循环周期是DAY(按天循环)时，输入格式为[{"startTime":"22:13","endTime":"22:21"}]（开始时间不能小于结束时间）。当生效时间类型为CYCLE_EFFECT（循环生效），且循环周期是WEEK(按周循环)时，输入格式为[{"startWeek":"1", "endWeek":"2" "startTime":"22:13","endTime":"22:21"}]（week参数取值为1-7，且开始时间不能小于结束时间）
parameters.name: time_slots

Operator.description_en:

`eq`: equal to.
`neq`: not equal to.
`in`: contains.
`nin`: does not contain.
`re`: matches regular expression.
`nre`: does not match regular expression

`nre`：正则不匹配
